interpretation: All timings are local whole-workerd-process CPU, not platform quota CPU.
Single-phase rows include their children and marker overhead; independent rows cannot be summed.
All-phase exclusive rows partition the instrumented root, not the uninstrumented baseline.
Microbenchmarks use independent repeated operations; prepared inputs and GC/JIT differ, so sub-benchmarks cannot be added as exact parent decompositions.
Resolution 1 ns is clock granularity, not accuracy.
